research_history_boundary.claim_scope: source- and ancestor-outcome-seen cross-axis candidate, not a pristine discovery or globally untouched market holdout

mechanism.name: Federal liquidity narrative sponsorship relay
mechanism.economic_object: a one-release change in archived Federal Reserve net liquidity supplies a weekly USD-liquidity impulse; a simultaneous rotation of Bitcoin news toward adoption or toward failure/constraint determines whether that impulse has crypto-specific narrative sponsorship
weak_signal_conjunction: H.4.1 net-liquidity impulse is public-macro and individually regime-dependent
GDELT category rotation is public narrative composition and individually weak
only same-direction agreement creates a candidate
new_geometry: event clock fixed by exogenous H.4.1 release availability
one-release liquidity change rather than FLCC's four/eight-release impulse
threshold-free sign of 7-day versus preceding-21-day narrative quality
seven-day consequence horizon matching the weekly release clock
explicitly_not: a threshold or hold repair of FLCC-1
a threshold/window repair of rejected GNRC
a BTC price, trend, funding, premium, OI, FX, or kimchi gate
a family grid selected from source incidence
an LLM-generated side, event, entry, exit, or hold

h41_source_contract.availability: archived release date at 16:35 America/New_York, already five minutes after the Federal Reserve's stated 16:30 release time
h41_source_contract.missing_or_invalid_release_policy: fail closed; no fill or skipped-rank repair

gdelt_source_contract.availability: source date UTC midnight + 48 hours + 15 minutes
gdelt_source_contract.zero_outage_policy: retain the audited all-zero daily rows exactly; pseudocount keeps quality finite
gdelt_source_contract.missing_or_invalid_day_policy: fail closed; exact daily grid required

causal_feature_contract.liquidity_impulse: current net_liquidity_usd_millions minus the immediately previous release; holiday spacing does not change the one-release definition
causal_feature_contract.liquidity_reference: exactly 104 prior one-release impulses excluding current; exact integer midrank numerator = 2*count(prior<current)+count(prior==current), denominator 208
causal_feature_contract.liquidity_side: LONG when numerator>=125, SHORT when numerator<=83, otherwise neutral
causal_feature_contract.latest_narrative_day: maximum GDELT source date whose audited available_at is <= current H.4.1 available_at_utc
causal_feature_contract.narrative_rotation: arithmetic mean q over the latest 7 consecutive source days minus arithmetic mean q over the immediately preceding 21 consecutive source days
causal_feature_contract.narrative_side: LONG when narrative_rotation>0, SHORT when <0, neutral when exactly zero
causal_feature_contract.primary: candidate only when liquidity_side and narrative_side are the same non-neutral side

execution_contract.entry: the exact UTC five-minute open at signal_time plus ten minutes
execution_contract.exit: entry plus exactly 2,016 five-minute bars / seven calendar days
execution_contract.side: fixed to the agreeing liquidity/narrative side
execution_contract.chronological_nonoverlap: accept when entry >= previous accepted exit; suppress rather than queue overlap
execution_contract.split_containment: signal, decision, entry, full hold, and exit must remain inside one half-open split
execution_contract.cagr: full declared calendar including warmup and idle cash
execution_contract.strict_mdd: global/pre-entry HWM with entry cost, exact funding, every held-bar favorable-then-adverse path, virtual adverse exit cost, and actual exit

source_support_gate.gate_domain: chronologically accepted split-contained primary clock; window attribution by entry_time with exit_time <= window end
source_support_gate.failure_action: reject without calculating a BTC post-entry return

source_only_novelty_gate.comparator_clock: primary for each frozen FLCC candidate
source_only_novelty_gate.matching: chronological deterministic one-to-one nearest match within plus/minus 15 minutes; ties choose earlier comparator entry
source_only_novelty_gate.failure_action: reject as an H.4.1 clock re-expression without opening BTC outcomes

source_only_controls.liquidity_only: every non-neutral H.4.1 liquidity tail, same side, scheduler, and execution
source_only_controls.narrative_only: every non-neutral narrative rotation sampled at H.4.1 releases, same side
source_only_controls.disagreement: when both sides are non-neutral and opposite, trade the liquidity side
source_only_controls.exact_side_flip: same primary timestamps with opposite side
source_only_controls.one_release_stale_narrative: current liquidity side combined with narrative_side sampled at the prior H.4.1 release
source_only_controls.deterministic_random_side: primary timestamps with NumPy default_rng seed from SHA256('FLNSR-2016|side')
source_only_controls.shared_control_contract: controls are report-only and cannot rescue or reject primary; every control uses the same availability delay, hold, nonoverlap, split containment, and clock-only schema; malformed controls fail the source build

strict_sequence.phase_2: hash-freeze strict evaluator before any FLNSR BTC outcome
strict_sequence.phase_4: open selection 2023 only if train passes

economic_gates.multiplicity_scope: one frozen FLNSR singleton; ancestor FLCC/GNRC outcome exposure is disclosed and prevents a global first-discovery claim

preferred_symbolic_context: liquidity shock side and causal percentile bucket
llm_boundary.reason: an LLM can arbitrate symbolic macro/narrative relations only after the causal base conjunction demonstrates economic edge; it cannot rescue a failed event
